Monsters.name: Lesser Demon
description: A lower-class demon often found patrolling cursed areas.
Weak to blessed weapons but dangerous in groups.

Monsters.name: Hellhound
description: A demonic canine creature with a fiery temperament.
Guards valuable loot in cursed dungeons.

Bosses.name: Demon Lord
description: A powerful demonic entity ruling over Cursed Prevalia.
Extremely dangerous - requires a well-prepared party to defeat.

Monsters.name: Skeletal Knight
description: An animated skeleton wearing ancient armor.
Resistant to physical attacks but weak to magic.

Monsters.name: Zombie
description: Reanimated corpse moving with shambling gait.
Slow but persistent enemies found in dungeons.

Bosses.name: Undead King
description: An ancient necromancer who rose from the dead.
Commands legions of undead creatures.

Monsters.name: Young Drake
description: A juvenile dragon still learning to hunt.
Dangerous with flame breath and sharp claws.

Monsters.name: Twisted Horror
description: A creature warped by dark magic beyond recognition.
Unpredictable and highly aggressive.

Bosses.name: Ancient Dragon
description: A massive dragon of incredible age and power.
One of the most formidable foes in the realm.

Monsters.name: Shadow Wraith
description: A spirit of pure darkness given form.
Immune to physical damage, requires special weapons.

Monsters.name: Abyssal Spawn
description: A creature pulled from the depths of the abyss.
Emanates an aura of pure malevolence.

Bosses.name: Abyssal Guardian
description: A powerful entity guarding the deepest dungeons.
The ultimate test of strength and courage.
